quarterly_data.signal: As of June 30, 2026, MPS's total estimated future unconditional purchase commitments to suppliers and other parties were $571.0 million, of which $542.1 million was due within a year, primarily wafer and other inventory purchases, assembly and other manufacturing services, construction of manufacturing and R&D facilities, purchases of production and other equipment, and license arrangements. The annually refundable deposit made to a supplier under a long-term wafer supply agreement was received back in the quarter ended March 31, 2026.
quarterly_data.figure: purchase commitments $571.0 million ($542.1 million due within a year) at June 30, 2026
